verify.method: each act compared this check (102 of 710: a seventh of the held acts, every one within 7 days, and the acts this check wrote) read again from www.belex.sites.be.ch (the act document and each version by id); every version held here against the collection's XHTML of the same day, letters and digits (the builder's letters check, ch_cantons.letters_check, so how a parse splits the text into files does not count); and the corpus's newest version rendered by the builder (gitlaw_common) against the files at the tip of main.
